description: Fictional supplied study records for local writing evaluation; no external lookup is needed or authorized by these fixtures.

cases.request: Use the supplied record to draft a Results paragraph and a two-sentence abstract conclusion in English. Preserve uncertainty and report missing evidence.

input.design: Single-site exploratory observational study; 40 participants per group; no randomized assignment.
input.result: Response: 17/40 in group A and 12/40 in group B; unadjusted risk ratio 1.42, 95% CI 0.78-2.58. The interval crosses 1. No prespecified primary endpoint was recorded.
input.missing: No adjustment for baseline differences was supplied. No external references were supplied.
input.draft: Our intervention proved superior and increased response by 42%. The groups were equivalent at baseline.

criteria: Preserves all counts and uncertainty
Does not infer causality, superiority or equivalence
Labels exploratory observational design
Does not invent a primary endpoint, adjustment or reference

cases.request: Write an evidence-grounded Review subsection about sensor reliability using only these records. Keep the commissioned focus on field reliability, including null evidence.

input.brief: Compare reliability in field settings. Do not turn the Review into a device catalogue or a claim of market adoption.

sources.record: Team A reports lower error on benchmark X; only one laboratory tested it.
The same team reanalyzed benchmark X with a different preprocessing step and observed lower error.
An independent field evaluation found no clear difference, with wide confidence intervals.

input.missing: No market data or interoperability standard was supplied. Coverage beyond these three excerpts is unknown.

criteria: Keeps field reliability as the governing question
Does not count S1 and S2 as independent replication
Includes S3 and its uncertainty
Bounds absence claims to the supplied record

cases.request: Draft a response to the reviewer asking for a new external validation cohort and a revised limitations sentence.

input.reviewer: Please validate the model in an independent hospital cohort and address generalizability.
input.completed_revision: Only the limitations paragraph was revised. It now says that single-hospital development leaves cross-hospital performance untested.
input.evidence: No external cohort is available, and no new analysis was performed.

criteria: Does not claim new analyses or completed external validation
States the limitation and the actual revision
Separates unmet request from completed text change
Uses a respectful, specific response

cases.request: Repair this bibliography without inventing metadata; provide a short verification report.

input.provider_observation: Crossref returned 404 for the queried source; no publisher result was available.
input.evidence: The standard's edition year and the online article's DOI and volume have not been assigned in the supplied record.

criteria: Keeps legitimate absent fields absent
Preserves article number
Does not label a Crossref404 as fabrication
Separates format checks from unresolved source identity

cases.request: Plan one figure from these measured results and write its legend. Do not generate artwork.

input.record: Three independent donors measured twice each; six technical measurements total. Each donor has values at baseline and day7. No inferential test has been supplied.

criteria: Uses paired donor-level presentation
Reports3 biological replicates and2 technical measurements each
Does not treat6 measurements as6 independent donors
Does not invent significance or a generated-image quota

cases.request: Plan a short journal-club slide deck in English from the Results record in results-and-abstract. Give slide text and speaker notes; do not claim a PPTX file was created.
criteria: English slide text and notes
Preserves uncertainty and observational design
Distinguishes outline from actual PPTX artifact

cases.request: Write a research-proposal objective and identify the evidence gaps from these preliminary notes.

input.record: Pilot observations suggest a possible association. No grant agency, budget, power calculation, ethics approval or independent validation has been specified.

criteria: Separates planned work from pilot evidence
Does not invent approval, power, funding or budget
Names missing decisions without blocking a bounded objective draft

cases.request: Explain the next writing step for converting this paper to a patent disclosure. Do not provide a legal opinion or file an application.

input.record: The paper is a scanned PDF with one unreadable equation; disclosure date, ownership and inventors are unresolved.

criteria: Routes to patent/disclosure workflow
Preserves uncertainty in OCR and ownership
Does not guess the equation
Does not imply patentability or filing completion
